author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 21: SOTA Replication (Scientia II 'Nudging' Method)
abstract:
This is a replication of the SOTA-achieving experiment from Scientia II (Archive #20).
It loads the base packing from Eval ID 416/375 (now saved to 'episteme/base_416_*') and applies the "nudging" optimization.
The SLSQP objective is penalized to encourage the formation of a contact between the (2,3) pair.
The goal is to reproduce the SOTA score of ~2.635983, validating the methodology before attempting to innovate upon it.
